mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings expectations and stock valuations.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth does not consistently correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-tests) over the observation period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 6.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower unemployment signals stronger labor market conditions and improved growth prospects.
failure_condition: If UNRATE crosses below 6.0% but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests) or the effect reverses within the window.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and decline in UNRATE (strong labor market) creates a synergistic effect that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by balancing inflation concerns with growth expectations.
failure_condition: If the interaction between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (Rank IC < 0.05) over 20-day windows, or returns do not follow the predicted positive direction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (industrial production) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger supply-side activity boosts demand and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth does not consistently correlate with positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-tests) over the observation period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary tightening raises borrowing costs and dampens economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% but 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-tests) or the effect reverses within the window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS below recent highs signals monetary easing that amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by reducing financial market volatility and supporting growth.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, if FEDFUNDS declines but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests), or the mechanism fails to hold outside this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (another demand indicator) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as combined demand signals stronger economic activity and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: If the combined GDPC1 and HOUST growth does not significantly predict positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-tests) or the effect is inconsistent.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above 95.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as industrial production growth indicates robust supply chain activity and expanded economic capacity.
failure_condition: If INDPRO crosses above 95.0 but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests) or the threshold is not consistently met.
